feature: PS-over-PS: PS lama otomatis di-revive sebelum PS baru diterapkan (Change suspension reason)
story: Tidak ada di OCMS18.1-18.5 (komentar code menyebut test plan OCMS 18.17-18.22)
note: Saat notice sudah PS dan petugas menerapkan kode PS lain, UI memanggil staff-revive-suspension lalu staff-apply-suspension, dan backend me-revive PS aktif dengan alasan CSR/PSR sebelum menyimpan PS baru. Mungkin dicakup story OCMS18.x lain di luar chunk ini; belum dicek.
note_en: When a notice is already PS and the officer applies a different PS code, the UI calls staff-revive-suspension and then staff-apply-suspension, and the backend revives the active PS with reason CSR/PSR before saving the new PS. It may be covered by another OCMS18.x story outside this chunk; not checked.

feature: Refund otomatis untuk notice paid yang dikenakan PS-APP/CAN/CFA/VST
note: PS pada notice paid hanya boleh dengan kode APP/CAN/CFA/VST; backend lalu membuat record refund (refund_reason PSR untuk staff portal) lewat refundNoticeService.createIfNotExists dan membersihkan field CRS. Kemungkinan dicakup story refund atau OCMS18.x lain; belum dicek. Tiket terkait: OCMS-DF-2026-075 (Closed), OCMS-DF-2026-152 (open, hanya jalur PLUS).
note_en: PS on a paid notice is only allowed with APP/CAN/CFA/VST; the backend then creates a refund record (refund_reason PSR for the staff portal) through refundNoticeService.createIfNotExists and clears the CRS fields. It is probably covered by a refund story or another OCMS18.x story; not checked. Related tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-075 (Closed), OCMS-DF-2026-152 (open, PLUS path only).

feature: Download hasil pencarian ke XLSX (Download All / Download Selected) dan Open Selected di tab baru
note: Tombol di toolbar hasil pencarian dan hasil upload mengekspor notice ke XLSX (batas 1000 notice) dan membuka notice terpilih di tab baru. Bukan bagian permanent suspension; mungkin dicakup story search/report lain.
note_en: Buttons in the search and upload result toolbars export notices to XLSX (limit 1000 notices) and open the selected notices in new tabs. Not part of permanent suspension; it may be covered by another search/report story.
